maddeler.e:
يصت (form I)
# يَصُتُّ (yaṣuttu) /ja.sˤut.tu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of صَتَّ (ṣatta)
# يُصَتُّ (yuṣattu) /ju.sˤat.tu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of صَتَّ (ṣatta)
# يَصُتَّ (yaṣutta) /ja.sˤut.ta/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of صَتَّ (ṣatta)
# يُصَتَّ (yuṣatta) /ju.sˤat.ta/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
